structure: CSharp interpolation binds the same parsed expression, receiver and result type as ordinary expressions. Native already has a complete AST/Typed IR bridge for scoped/suspending/numeric-generic fragments; use it for every real flow target in the typed product consumed by semantic.analysis. Keep the existing flat lowering API as the retained projection for original IR observers; both APIs use one parser core.
branches: CSharp readonly Deque front/back, Heap peek, UInt16/Text results and Double comparison results, explicit arity and free-function fallback; original BitSet read controls. Constructors reject wrong arity first, then nonliteral/nonpositive capacities at the argument, using raw NumberExpression text parsed as positive Long. Shared Deque/BinaryHeap rules retain source names and coordinates.
logic: No new scalar-only or collection-specific interpolation emitters. Complete ordinary expression types and owner state feed existing kind17 materialization. Source diagnostics inspect the resolved builtin collection identity and actual constructor name, not arbitrary calls returning a collection; bind only active declaration bodies. Preserve all original fixture outputs and legacy IR projections.
diagnostics: Positive literal error matches CSharp exact module/argument span; constructor arity matches constructor span. Do not accept zero, change expected diagnostics, simplify front out of interpolation, or widen printability (Double results are compared as Bool because direct Double interpolation is rejected by current CSharp).
